conclusion.interpretation: Numerically sound compression and per-batch routing, but no broadly safe Auto replacement. Membership building did not deliver the planned universal setup reduction. Hubs pay setup then decline cells. Easy-four-worker timing variation affects identical routes and remains unexplained.
conclusion.next_direction: Decide whether construction can pay before building, using a cheap bounded structural census; separately diagnose easy-four-worker variability. Preserve the beneficial original cell solver and avoid treating lane-control outcomes as a selected replacement.
